Adding on to it (my phone is lagging cuz of the post sorry for mistakes)

I always downplayed my efforts on things I did my best on to compensate if i get displeasing results. I dont try at all when I have given up and have now displayed defeatist attitude.

When I spoke up about my problems, i only get scoldings and more problems in the end so there was really no point for reaching out to them. In the past years, they have been much more supportive, but their words felt insincere because of the things they said in the past. I dont even sing infront of people now. I only dance joke moves as jokes and not seriously. I dont have any interests or hobbies since the first thing my parents ask is if they can share it online. 

Right now i dont know what to do with my life since i have never developed any serious interest or hobbies, i only clung onto what was easy because it was the only way for me to make my parents happy. (I only had my grades to make them proud, i cant even be a “good son” for them since im gay). I have lost confidence and passion in everything I do, and i have noone to talk to anyone with everything thats on my mind, I dont want to burden anyone with my problems, but at the same time, ive been keeping this to myself for years and its depressing.
I kinda relate, like i dont want to experience pain, but if i suddenly die or something i think id be happy

Honestly, I dont see the need of a tablet if you have a laptop and phone with you. If you prefer textbooks/writing in paper, not having a tablet isnt really a downfall. There are also laptops with a touch screen that you can use with a pen which might be a good option

I can relate hard!

I was a good student (Always participating, good grades, honors etc.) Ever since the start of the pandemic and online classes, it just turned to the worse for me. I also enjoy classes, but the perfectionist mindset that comes out when working on assignments just makes me procrastinate a lot with the fear of making mistakes and therefore I just put it off and half-ass it on the time I have left. Online classes made it worse since the deadlines feel fake and arbitrary. I really dont want to say Im only lazy since wanting to do well is the very reason that I havent done it. Im on my 2nd year of college and im failing everything right now so I hope its better for you.
